Section 7 of Executive Order No. 119 (s. 2002) is hereby
amended to read as follows:
Assumption and Payment by PSALM of Rural Electrification
Loans. -Pursuant
to Section 60 of EPlRA, PSALM shall assume all Rural
Electrification Loans upon the effectivity thereof.

Where necessary, such contracts and/or agreements may include mutual
stipulations on the modification and/or amendments of existing contracts
of mortgage and other security between ECs and NEA or other creditor
